decision.next_action: compare the compiled host formula, six-urea/amide motif counts and graph fingerprint with the published truncated GluHUT drawing and source synthesis; request source mol2/frcmod/RESP and exact starting coordinates

limitations: AMBER topology bonds and atom types define a compiled graph but do not preserve the original quantum-chemistry or RESP derivation.
Bond order is not explicitly reconstructed; carbonyl motifs use equilibrium bond length and neighbour elements.
The host graph is a truncated public GluHUT benchmark, not the complete NNC2215 conjugate.
Internal consistency and formula agreement do not prove chemical correctness or transferability.

scope: four public GluHUT sugar benchmark topologies
